text:
Incident Bot: paging: high tail latency detected in ingress -> router fanout (us-west2). p95 ~ 480ms, p99 ~ 2.8s, streaming stalls observed. Impact: some streaming responses time out, several customer errors. Auto-escalate to oncall. :rotating_light:
Marc: oncall here, looking. seeing the alert. linking graphs.
Marc: key metric snapshots —
```
p50: 120ms
p95: 480ms
p99: 2800ms
error rate (streaming): 1.8% -> 3.6% last 5m
open connections to router: +35% in us-west2
```
Jen: thanks, Marc. is this an LB fanout increase or router kernel stall?
Priya: I can jump in for routing table checks, on my way.
Marc: initial grep of router logs shows repeated 502s and long tail for requests routed to shard-7 and shard-11. suspect hot partitioning.
Aaron: customers on dedicated capacity? any enterprise P0s?
Support Bot: 3 Support cases flagged as "streaming stall" in last 10m: cust-tilo, cust-alpha, cust-mint. severity: medium-high.
Marc: summary from trace sampling: most stalled requests have route_policy=fanout_v2 and selected backend variant weight skewed to zone-a.
Danny: pulled routing table snapshot: weight distribution looks normal, but key hashing shows heavy collisions onto shard-11 for this keyspace. suspect recent release of routing policy change at 14:22.
Jen: rolling back policy on prod? or quick mitigation: bias routing to prefer alternate shard set and reduce weight for shard-11.
Marc: plan: 1) short-term: apply emergency routing override to reduce shard-11 weight by 70% for 10m 2) instrument more tracing 3) follow-on: revert faulty policy rollout and run canary.
Priya: runbook for emergency override is /runbooks/router-routing-override. I'll execute with Marc.
Marc: running command now.
```
# emergency override
curl -X POST https://router-control.internal/override \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ROUTER_ADMIN" \n  -d '{"zone":"us-west2","shard":"shard-11","weight_delta":-0.7,"duration_secs":600}'
```
Marc: override applied. verifying.
Danny: seeing immediate drop in queued requests for shard-11. p95 trending down to ~220ms in us-west2 within 30s. p99 dropping from 2.8s -> 900ms.
Jen: nice, keep monitoring for 15m. Priya, please start a controlled rollback of the policy rollout that shipped at 14:22 to confirm root cause.
Priya: starting rollback now. ETA ~4m.
Aaron: notifying affected customers with templated note. Will include ETA and mitigation steps.
Support Bot: sent notifications to cust-tilo and cust-alpha (tickets linked).
Marc: streaming stalls count in last 5m went from 42 -> 6 after override. still residual.
Jen: hypothesis: policy bug caused fanout weight calculation to amplify hot keys onto shard-11 (non-uniform hashing change). The override reduces load but we need a patch.
Danny: created a hotfix branch to fix weight normalization and added unit test for non-uniform key distribution. PR #3142.
Marc: can we enable fallback to fallback-model variant for streaming sessions hitting shard-11? might reduce KV miss penalties.
Jen: yes, enabling eager-fallback for streaming routes in region us-west2 as temporary measure. Marcus please flip the toggle.
Marc: toggled eager-fallback=true for fanout_v2 in us-west2.
```
# enable eager fallback
curl -X PATCH https://router-control.internal/configs/fanout_v2 \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ROUTER_ADMIN" \n  -d '{"region_overrides": {"us-west2": {"eager_fallback": true}}}'
```
Marc: after both override + fallback toggle, p99 stabilized ~380ms, errors down to 0.6%.
Priya: rollback complete. monitoring shows policy version restored to v12 (pre-release). Root cause confirmed: release v13 introduced a normalization bug.
Jen: good work. tickets for follow-up:
- ENG-1879: revert/patch release pipeline to block bad normalization changes
- ENG-1880: add canary for weight distribution (synthetic hotkey sim)
- SRE-652: improve alerting to include hotkey concentration heatmap
Marc: handoff to Jen for post-incident coordination and customer comms. I'll keep monitoring for 30m.
Jen: taking over. I'll prepare incident summary and customer-facing timeline. cc @product-ops for severity classification.
Aaron: support will follow up with affected customers and offer mitigation credits where appropriate.
Support Bot: updated incident ticket INC-2026, linked logs and graphs.
Marc: note for postmortem — include kernel-level packets for router shard process around 14:23 and the policy rollout artifact id.
Danny: PR #3142 opened, will submit for review now.
Jen: initial RCA: routing policy rollout (v13) included normalization logic regression leading to hotkey amplification and misrouting to shard-11 -> overload -> tail latency and streaming stalls. Immediate mitigation: emergency override + eager-fallback toggle + rollback.
Jen: timeline draft will be posted in #postmortems in 1h. If anyone has more traces, paste here.
Priya: adding tracing link: https://traces.internal/trace/0a1b2c3d (sample).
Marc: thanks everyone. continuing to monitor, will call clear when sustained for 45m. :white_check_mark:
Jen: clear to handoff. oncall shift: Jen now primary.
Incident Bot: Incident updated: status=mitigated, severity=prod-degraded -> monitoring.
Jen: post-incident action items assigned and I'll schedule a postmortem meeting tomorrow.
Support Bot: Notifying customers that mitigations are in place and we'll follow up with root cause analysis.
Marc: left a quick note in deploy logs: "emergency override applied - revert once patch lands".
Jen: thanks all. closing thread once metrics hold for 45m.
